text: Consider backward-compatible config migration for ralph_dir to gromit_dir — existing users with ralph.yaml configs referencing .ralph/ paths won't automatically migrate. Needs product decision on whether to support migration or clean break.

Consider extracting resolve*Dir helpers (resolveGromitDir, resolveSpecsDir, resolvePlansDir) to a shared file like cmd/gromit/resolve.go. All follow the same pattern (check config, fallback to default) but are spread across main.go, refine.go, and plan.go. Low-priority cleanup — needs judgment on whether consolidation is worth the churn given each is only 6 lines.
we should offer to run decompose after plan (in a subagent)
when asked which soec to plan, we should show which are already planned
Make it configurable for all Claude interactive sessions launched by gromit to use --dangerously-skip-permissions

Consider extracting --no-chain flag name to a constant. The string '--no-chain' appears in multiple places across chain.go, plan.go, and decompose.go. If the flag name ever changes, all sites need updating. A package-level constant like chainOptOut = "no-chain" would centralize this. Low-priority cleanup, only warranted if more chaining flags are added.
When choosing what to refine, offer a 'something new' option that starts refinement from a blank idea instead of requiring an existing backlog item
When a user tells Claude to add something to the backlog in a gromit project, Claude should use 'gromit add' rather than creating a bead directly
Consider creating a Claude skill that gets installed for interacting with gromit, so users can orchestrate the pipeline (add, refine, plan, decompose, run) directly from Claude
dont ask to decompose after planning if the plan has already been decomposed

Consider making success learning extraction timeout configurable. extractSuccessLearning uses a hardcoded 30-second timeout. Other timeouts in the runner (bead_timeout, analysis_timeout, stall_timeout_active) are configurable via gromit.yaml. If haiku becomes slower or users want to tune this, there's no config knob.
allow user to run a configurable command between iterations
user should be able to configure for TDD to be turned on, or ATDD
if decompose called without arguments gove a list of unndecomposed plans, or the option to decompose all one by one
Expand gromit status to show much more info — plan/decompose state, spec status, pipeline progress, not just bead/iteration info

Harden fake claude script file creation against path traversal — CLAUDE_WRITE_FILE is not validated before use in mkdir -p and file write, and echo interprets escape sequences in CLAUDE_WRITE_CONTENT (should use printf instead)
E2E refine tests use hardcoded picker indices (e.g. stdin '3' for Something new) that are fragile to UI changes — consider parsing picker output to determine correct choice number
Eliminate documentary tests that re-implement chain logic instead of calling actual functions
Add pipeline state file staleness protection - check created_at timestamp before consuming stale state
Deduplicate spec-name extraction pattern and ExitError handling across cmd/gromit files
